description:
Out of the five Wyoming projects from 2018, people consider KIDS SEE GHOSTS one of the best. This album focuses heavily on overcoming struggles caused by mental health, which Kanye and Cudi have been fighting. It's characterized by many psychedelic and rock-influenced elements, making for an album that sounds like nothing else. The album was originally meant to release on New Year's Eve 2017 under the name Everybody Wins, but didn't officially release until June 8th, 2018, making it Kanye's second collab album.

title: Unknown [Ty Dolla $ign Collaborations]
description: Ty said in an IG Live stream that he was almost done his collaborative album with Kanye, saying "Me and Kanye making it together. They left to Africa though, so I'm doing my parts now. Producer damn james! later stated than Kanye wanted to produce and album for Ty Dolla $ign and that was "the original idea for VULTURES". Possibly a 7-track album like Kanye's 2018 Wyoming releases due to Kanye expressing interest to do one with Ty in a 2018 Big Boy interview.  Additionally, Ty would repost a clip of this interview to Instagram on June 4, 2018, captioned "U ready ?".
